Key Tactical Trainings Suggested
Focus #1

Focus on strike-rotations in the middle overs to prevent pressure building up.

Focus #2

Make sure your frontline bowlers are bowling in the powerplay and death overs of the defensive splits.

Focus #3

Practice direct-hits in fielding drills this week to force run-outs.

Data Backup / Recovery Engine

You can export or import your data JSON files below. The import parser automatically reads and resolves both New Formats (including players, configurations, and schedules) and Old Legacy Formats (built purely on match arrays). If players are omitted, the importer rebuilds player registries, automatically assigning default roles so you never lose historic stats!

Danger Zone — Clear Database
